description: This file contains the PHP source code for the admin extension report controller in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines the 'Report' class with methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling report extensions, handling configuration, permissions, and dynamic loading of report modules.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Controller class for managing report extensions in the OpenCart admin panel. It handles listing available reports, installing/uninstalling extensions, and rendering the report view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that outputs the list of reports.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the list of report extensions, loading available extensions, installed extensions, and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to install a report extension, updating permissions and extension status, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to uninstall a report extension, updating permissions and extension status, and returning JSON response.
